svg.text: A home where music doesn‘t just play—it actually lives 🎹 For
Vanessa, the piano is where she teaches, plays, and shares
those quiet, wonder-filled moments with her toddler. We didn’t
just find a spot for the keys; we built the entire home around
them. From the foyer’s circular cutout that perfectly frames
the first note you see to the curved ceilings that carry the
sound through the house, every inch is designed to celebrate
her craft. It’s a beautiful reminder that your home should be
a stage for the things you love most. Is there a ”centerpiece“
in your life that your home should be built around? ——
